## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Fix # (issue).

## Type of change
Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement

## Motivation and Context
Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?
If it fixes an open issue, please link to the issue here.

## How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Manual testing
- [ ] Performance benchmarks (if applicable)

Provide instructions for how to run the tests:
```bash
cargo test
```

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules

## Performance Impact
If this change affects performance, please provide benchmark results:
- Before: [performance metric]
- After: [performance metric]
- Impact: [describe impact]

## Breaking Changes
If this change introduces breaking changes, please describe:
- What changes are breaking?
- How should users migrate to the new version?
- Is there a deprecation period?
